attributes.name: ypy-retry
attributes.description: Repeats a failed request, with exponential backoff and optional jitter. Off unless set. A bare attribute means 3 attempts; `false`, `on:never` or `attempts:0` turns it off for the element. By default only a request that could not reach the server is repeated; `on:error` also repeats a 5xx answer. Only safe methods are repeated unless `unsafe:true`.

values.name: false
values.description: Do not repeat requests of this element.

modifiers.name: attempts:<n>
modifiers.description: How many times a failed request is repeated. 3 for a bare attribute, else 0.

modifiers.name: on:<mode>
modifiers.description: What counts as a failure. `network` (default): the request did not reach the server. `error`: also a response with status 500 or more. `always`: also any response with status 400 or more. `never`: do not repeat. A 503 or 429 that is repeated waits at least its `Retry-After`.

modifiers.name: delay:<time>
modifiers.description: Wait before the first repeat. Default `1s`.

modifiers.name: max:<time>
modifiers.description: Longest wait between two attempts. Default `30s`.

modifiers.name: backoff:<n>
modifiers.description: Each wait is this many times longer than the one before. Default 2; `1` keeps it constant.

modifiers.name: jitter:<n>
modifiers.description: Each wait varies at random by up to this fraction (`0.2`) or percentage (`20%`), up and down, so clients do not retry at the same moment. Default `0`; `0` keeps the waits exact.

modifiers.name: methods:<list>
modifiers.description: Narrows the repeated methods. Default `GET HEAD QUERY`.

modifiers.name: unsafe:true
modifiers.description: Repeat every method, including POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

events.name: ypy:request:retry
events.description: Fires on the source element before a failed request is repeated, after `delay` ms or when the window goes online. `attempt` is 1 for the first repeat. `status` is the status of the answer that is repeated, absent after a network failure. Cancel it to give up; the error is then reported as usual, or the answer is handled as without retry.

config.name: retry
config.description: Default retry options for the whole page; the `ypy-retry` attribute overrides them per element.

config.name: retry.attempts
config.description: How many times a failed request is repeated.

config.name: retry.on
config.description: What counts as a failure: `network` (the request did not reach the server), `error` (also a 5xx answer), `always` (also a 4xx answer) or `never`.

config.name: retry.delay
config.description: Wait before the first repeat, in milliseconds or as `"1s"`.

config.name: retry.max
config.description: Longest wait between two attempts, in milliseconds or as `"30s"`.

config.name: retry.backoff
config.description: Each wait is this many times longer than the one before. `1` keeps it constant.

config.name: retry.jitter
config.description: How much each wait varies at random, as a fraction (`0.2`) or a percentage (`"20%"`), up and down. `0` keeps the waits exact.

config.name: retry.methods
config.description: Methods that are repeated, a space or comma separated string or an array of upper-case names. It can only narrow the safe methods.

config.name: retry.unsafe
config.description: Repeat every method, including POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. The server may have run the first attempt.
